PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT ?zone ?zoneName ?sensor ?sensorType WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?sensor .
  ?sensor a ?sensorType .
  FILTER (regex(str(?sensorType), "Electric_Power", "i"))
}
